retrievalProfile.description: A high-key portrait integrated into expressive black ink splatters and textured brushwork against a stark white void.
excludeWhen: dark or moody low-key lighting is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female subject with eyes closed in a serene expression, emerging from a chaotic but balanced composition of black ink splatters, dry brush textures, and occasional orange-brown accents. The lighting is extremely bright (high-key), washing out the background into pure white, while the subject's dark clothing provides a heavy visual anchor.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the focal point of serenity amidst chaotic ink textures
Contrast between the sharp, geometric typography and the organic, fluid paint splatters
Heavy black mass at the bottom-left balancing the negative space at the top-right
Subtle warm accents (orange/brown) echoing the subject's hair color
coreInvariants: Aggressive ink splatter and brushstroke textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, slightly tilted, occupying the middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dense black mass of the subject's clothing and the large ink stroke on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the serene face, follows the upward diagonal of the left ink stroke, then moves to the typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space on the right side and top edge to provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt Orange/Copper (Hair and minor paint flecks)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the warm hair tones.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thin (hairline) weight for primary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'm' and 'n' have rounded, continuous arches
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with weight and color variation.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and lowercase aesthetic.
Provides the necessary thinness and geometric rigor.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a woman with closed eyes and a serene expression. Integrate her into a composition of heavy black ink splatters and dry brush textures against a pure white background. Add subtle copper-colored paint flecks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a geometric hairline sans-serif font, typeset the artist name in black lowercase in the top right. Below it, typeset the title in a muted gold color with wide tracking, also in lowercase.

verificationChecks: Are the eyes of the subject closed?
Is the typography lowercase and geometric?
Are there visible ink splatter textures?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the specific celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the ink splatters don't obscure the facial features.
Check that the hairline font is legible against the white background.
Verify the color of the subtitle matches the warm accents in the image.
Confirm the composition maintains a balance between the heavy left side and the light right side.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Organic Ink Splatters + Geometric Hairline Typography + White Negative Space
